verdict.rationale: A GPU cloud platform could plausibly offer a dedicated sandbox or test mode isolated from production data, so this axis applies. The evidence documents no such capability. Machine creation, custom templates, snapshots and team-scoped API keys are general building blocks a user could arrange into a test setup, but they are not a product-provided sandbox. Nothing in the pack describes test environments isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
